yarn-troppo.meaning: All the facts survive (three F-5s, Oct. 11, 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. EDT, the Artemis dome, MAX POWER on Nov. 7 and 8). Asides react to the original ("Not your usual coin toss, is it?", "Mind it doesn't take off with the littlies, ay.", "Flying cars by the weekend, I reckon. Well, maybe not."). "all in the one room" is a small invented detail for a touring programme.
yarn-troppo.sense: Terms fit: "having a yarn with the punters", "have a burl at", "happy snap", "the uni types, the industry mob", "down the track". "all in the one room" strains for a tour with many stops.
yarn-troppo.authenticity: Mostly natural ("a whopping great blow-up SLS", "show-and-tell of American air and space smarts"), but "Now, this one's a ripper." is a stock opener and "head honcho" is generic.
yarn-troppo.register: A full level-4 retelling; no swearing, within vulgarity 1.
yarn-troppo.tone: The upbeat promotional tone carries through as a cheerful yarn; the jokes ("Flying cars by the weekend, I reckon. Well, maybe not.") suit an excited announcement.
yarn-troppo.flow: Reads well aloud; the final paragraph is a little choppy ("it runs a few days, and it's fine for the whole family").
yarn-troppo.variety: Varied: "rock up", "have a burl", "happy snap", "littlies", "doing the rounds", "finishes with a bang".
yarn-troppo.essence: Unmistakably the NASA flyover announcement, retold with relish.

yarn-dinkum.meaning: Every point survives with nothing invented: "the multi-day, family-friendly do will show off the next-generation aircraft".
yarn-dinkum.sense: All terms fit: "having a yarn with the fans", "rock up", "mob", "do", "down the track".
yarn-dinkum.authenticity: Natural throughout: "a public show-and-tell of American air and space know-how".
yarn-dinkum.register: Measured, about level 3: plain lines like "NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman's going to be at the controls" sit beside light slang. Lighter than the brief.
yarn-dinkum.flow: Smooth; reads like it was written that way.
yarn-dinkum.variety: Some range ("yarn", "rock up", "mob", "do", "snap a few pics") for its light touch.

engine.meaning: The original verbatim with British spellings ("organisations", "honour"); nothing lost.
engine.sense: No Aussie terms to take a wrong sense; "organisations" and "honour" are only spellings.
engine.authenticity: No Aussie voice at all; it reads as a US press release: "convenes academic, industry, and public sector stakeholders".
engine.register: Left untranslated: "NASA team members will engage with fans". Far under level 4.
engine.tone: The press-release tone is the original's, unchanged.

unharnessed.meaning: Every fact survives; "Not a bad way to start the footy, eh?" is colour.
unharnessed.sense: Mostly exact ("at the stick", "punters", "shindig", "happy snaps"), but "the footy" for an NFL game takes an Australian code's word for gridiron.
unharnessed.authenticity: Natural: "have a crack at some interactive games", "rounds up the academic, industry and public sector mob". "Not a bad way to start the footy, eh?" sounds slightly off for gridiron.
unharnessed.register: Level 4 weight; "a bloody big inflatable SLS" is within vulgarity 1.
unharnessed.flow: Smooth: "The tour wraps up with a bang at MAX POWER".

dinkum-3.meaning: Every fact survives; "keep the Yanks out in front in space" gives "American leadership" a slangier name but the same claim.
dinkum-3.sense: Terms fit: "gridiron game", "having a yarn", "happy snap", "down the track", "driverless vehicles".
dinkum-3.authenticity: Natural mostly ("a whopping great blow-up SLS"), but "Okay, so." is an American-style opener, not Australian.
dinkum-3.tone: Upbeat tone kept; "the Yanks" adds a faint wry edge to a NASA promo.
dinkum-3.flow: Smooth apart from the opening "Okay, so."
dinkum-3.variety: Varied: "pop under", "have a crack", "happy snap", "players", "next lot of".

yarn-troppo.original: convenes academic, industry, and public sector stakeholders
yarn-troppo.why: "in the one room" invents a single meeting for a multi-stop tour.

summaries.yarn-troppo: A lively, natural level-4 yarn that keeps every fact; a stock opener aside, the best fit to the brief.
summaries.yarn-dinkum: Faithful and natural, but lighter than the level-4 brief.
summaries.unharnessed: Natural, well-weighted and faithful; one footy-for-gridiron slip.
summaries.dinkum-3: Natural level-4 retelling with correct gridiron; a filler opener and "the Yanks" are small blemishes.
